shortDescription: Interface with dnsimple.com (a DNS hosting service)

options.name: account_api_token
options.description: Account API token. See O(account_email) for more information.

options.name: account_email
options.description: Account email. If omitted, the environment variables E(DNSIMPLE_EMAIL) and E(DNSIMPLE_API_TOKEN) are looked for. If those variables are not found, a C(.dnsimple) file is looked for, see: U(https://github.com/mikemaccana/dnsimple-python#getting-started). C(.dnsimple) config files are only supported in dnsimple-python<2.0.0.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain to work with. Can be the domain name (for example V(mydomain.com)) or the numeric ID of the domain in DNSimple. If omitted, a list of domains is returned. If domain is present but the domain does not exist, it is created.

options.name: record
options.description: Record to add, if blank a record for the domain is created, supports the wildcard (*).

options.name: record_ids
options.description: List of records to ensure they either exist or do not exist.

options.name: sandbox
options.description: Use the DNSimple sandbox environment. Requires a dedicated account in the dnsimple sandbox environment. Check U(https://developer.dnsimple.com/sandbox/) for more information.

options.name: solo
options.description: Whether the record should be the only one for that record type and record name. Only use with O(state) is set to V(present) on a record.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the record should exist or not.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The TTL to give the new record in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of DNS record to create.

options.name: value
options.description: Record value. Must be specified when trying to ensure a record exists.
